name: Dormant organiser — 30 days without a round
description: A club organiser who opened a round and has not opened another in 30 days. When an organiser goes quiet the whole club churns with them, so this reaches the one person rather than the fifteen. Entry is game_created, not an is_admin attribute: it targets whoever actually runs the evening, not whoever holds the permission.

config._note: Whoever opens rounds IS the organiser. Better targeting than an is_admin attribute — and it needs no attribute we don't already send.
Waits 30 days for another round to be opened. Leaving through `did` means all is well and there is nothing to say; only timed_out reaches the push.
Body copy stays Hebrew — it is the only text a player reads.
config.title: המגרש מחכה ⚽
config.body: חודש בלי מחזור. פתיחה לוקחת פחות מדקה, והשחקנים שלך כבר יודעים את התרגיל.
